# GitHub automation

`.github/` contains repository-hosted automation. Validation uses disposable CI fixtures and the same public scripts as release operators. Explicit manual publication uses the registered `admin-production` SSH identity to verify and activate a complete release against the original service; ordinary publication checks migrations without DDL. Real Provider calls remain a separate acceptance stage.

`ADMIN_DATABASE_MODE` is an `admin-production` environment variable (`embedded-postgres` until an explicit external-database cutover; `postgres` afterwards). It asserts the root-owned receiver configuration and cannot change the database target. Both SSH commands carry this assertion. External mode verifies all five role URLs and the configured PostgreSQL cluster/database identity, then starts the app without an embedded database.

As of the 2026-11-14 cutover, the active environment variable and server mode are both `postgres`. The SSH deployment host remains the application host; the database host is configured separately in the root-owned receiver and private runtime URLs.

| Path | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `workflows/` | Push/PR validation and main-only manual Admin release; both run `test:release-receiver`. |
